title: NotesToGo
summary: An iPad note-taking app exploring handwritten documents, local organization and editable PDF workflows.
content:
I am building NotesToGo as a native iPad app for handwritten, multipage notes. The app combines a local file explorer with a document editor built using SwiftUI and PaperKit.

Document workflows

The project explores page organization, manual saving and reliable handling of file operations and errors. Flux structures feature state and asynchronous work, while Factory provides dependency injection.

PDF-first development

An ongoing development effort explores self-contained PDFs that remain visible in other readers while retaining native editing information. This is work in progress, not a claim that every PDF workflow is complete or that the app is available in the App Store.
